meta.name: add-whatsapp
meta.description: Add WhatsApp channel via native Baileys adapter. Direct connection — no Chat SDK bridge. Uses QR code or pairing code for authentication.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 接入 WhatsApp 渠道,直接收发消息
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在开发需要与 WhatsApp 收发消息的应用或机器人.
copy.tagline_en: Connect WhatsApp channel for direct messaging
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building an app or bot that needs to send and receive WhatsApp messages.

howto.what: 添加 WhatsApp 频道:从 channels 分支复制原生 Baileys 适配器和 whatsapp-formatting 技能,注册后安装依赖、跑构建与注册测试;再用扫码或配对码把 WhatsApp 连为已链接设备,并把号码模式与助手名写入 .env。
howto.when: 当你想让 NanoClaw 接入 WhatsApp 时触发;安装前必做号码安全检查(专用号还是个人号),再用扫码或配对码认证。若 store/auth/creds.json 已存在,则跳过链接步骤。

say.text: 用 WhatsApp 专用号接入 NanoClaw
say.note: 会先问你用专用号还是共用号

say.text: 用配对码方式链接 WhatsApp
say.note: 会要你的号码并显示 8 位配对码

howto.what_en: Adds a WhatsApp channel: copies the native Baileys adapter and whatsapp-formatting skill from the channels branch, installs deps, builds and tests the registration, then links WhatsApp via QR or pairing code.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want NanoClaw to use WhatsApp. It runs a required number-safety check (dedicated vs personal) before installing, then links the device by QR or pairing code.

say_en.text: Add WhatsApp to NanoClaw on a dedicated number
Link WhatsApp with a pairing code
